# Command, end to end

`runbooks test` runs this runbook as phase 2's exit test (`packages/cli/src/main.test.ts`). Each block checks something Command promises, so a Command that breaks one fails the test.

`setup` logs with the helpers, gives an output and a variable, and writes a file to `generated/` through a path relative to the folder it starts in, the run's folder.

<Command
  id="setup"
  outputs={["region"]}
  command={`log_info "setting up" || exit 9
echo "region=us-east-1" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"
echo "FROM_SETUP=eu-west-2" >> "$RUNBOOK_ENV"
mkdir -p generated
echo made > generated/made-by-setup.txt`}
/>

`consume` runs a script file. It gets `FROM_SETUP` through `envFrom`, and setup's region through `env`.

<Command
  id="consume"
  path="scripts/consume.sh"
  envFrom={["setup"]}
  env={{ REGION: "{{ .outputs.setup.region }}" }}
  outputs={["seen"]}
/>

`fails` exits 3, so its run fails.

<Command id="fails" command="exit 3" />
